summary: HEY-06: policy_client fetches and verifies the central routing contract (shared by willman)

delivery.outcome: subllm.policy_client.fetch_routing_contract(endpoint, application, function) is the one shared client for the central routing contract: a bounded subllm.query/v1 export-routing-contract request, closed-field/version/profile/candidate validation, RFC 8785 digest verification, a per-profile single-flight TTL cache; unavailable endpoints raise PolicyEndpointUnavailable (RuntimeError), invalid answers InvalidRoutingContract (ValueError), so willman's subllm_routing can delegate to it without behaviour change (HEY-06).
nonGoals: willman migration needs a subllm release first (willman pins subactor-subllm>=1.4,<2).
No change to the Policy API server side.

architecture.decision: Move the verified-fetch logic from willman/subllm_routing.py into the SDK, reusing poa.canonical.digest_document and the registry's EXPORT_CONTRACT_URI.
architecture.rollback: Revert; no consumer uses it yet.
